basis: Locked global integration contract already requires cancellation to clear all server-owned preview handles; migration-specific endpoint list omits the mechanism. Adding the matching cancel endpoint implements that existing invariant, without new data effects or business capability. Original SPEC/WO bytes remain frozen.

contract.guards: Same session cookie, Host/origin, X-Ca-Request, JSON/type and exact context checks; permitted in restricted migration session alongside preview/confirm/status/shutdown.
contract.effect: Idempotently clear only pending schema-upgrade plan in current context. No DB/file/catalog mutation; no restore or migration starts.
contract.response: Successful JSON acknowledgment with cancelled:true; whether a plan existed need not leak. Failed guard follows locked stable error contract.
requiredTests: preview -> cancel -> confirm original nonce returns409STALE, source and backups unchanged
cancel with no pending plan succeeds without new effects
wrong context/auth/header/origin/unknownfield rejected without clearing another context plan
UI cancellation increments generation and late preview response cannot restore nonce/dialog; confirming state cannot masquerade as cancelled migration

recoveryCaveat: Failed intermediate legacy upgrade retains verified pre-upgrade copies and clear explicit restore route. Component/sourcebytes tests do not prove actual consumer recovery; native Tk or equivalent actual admitted user path must be evidenced before L5/L8 acceptance, otherwise remain unproved.
limits: No product acceptance or silent waiver of native print/runtime recovery. No source edits by reviewer.
